positions.title: AI Engineer Intern
description: Shipped an AI IT support agent that automatically resolves 42% of tickets across 9 brands, cutting an 800+ ticket backlog.

Engineered the retrieval pipeline across bilingual docs, an LLM query-rewriting layer feeding hybrid vector and keyword search on Azure AI Search over OpenAI embeddings, returning grounded answers with citations and a ~2–3s first token.
Fine-tuned a cross-encoder reranker in PyTorch on 1,400 resolved tickets, lifting retrieval recall@5 from 74% to 88%.

Cut monthly budget categorization from 6+ hours to 5 minutes with a LangGraph agent that fixes vendors and GL codes across 1000+ transactions via Claude API, validated by an evaluation harness against finance's hand-done records.

positions.title: Software Engineering Intern
description: Developed a recommendation engine that ranks 100+ office chairs against each user's measurements through layered filtering and weighted scoring across 15 ergonomic attributes, deployed as a FastAPI service powering a React Native app.

Cut validation defects per sprint by 32% across the flagship mobile app by writing 40+ Jest and React Testing Library regression tests covering user sign-in flows and AI-driven measurement capture, run in a CI/CD pipeline on each merge.
